description: This file contains utility functions for generating OpenAPI schemas and documentation for a FastAPI project. It includes functions for extracting path parameters, request bodies, security schemes, and generating the overall OpenAPI spec, supporting custom routes and callbacks.

classes.name: OpenAPI
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the OpenAPI schema.

methods.description: Generates the OpenAPI Path object for a specific route, including parameters, responses, request bodies, and callbacks.

methods.description: Assembles the complete OpenAPI schema for a set of FastAPI routes and optionally Webhooks.
